objective: Executable contemporary CMB comparison following Dovekie arXiv2511.07517v2 section4.2, with source/configuration ambiguities explicitly exposed.
components: Plik-lite cut to complete bins below TT1000/TE600/EE600
SPT-3G2018 lensing Pan2023 with CMB-dependent corrections
no_double_lensing: Standalone Planck2018 lensing is omitted when the joint ACT+Planck likelihood is used. Newer SPT2026 lensing is not substituted for Pan2023.
calibration_ambiguity: Paper section4.3 states A_ACT=P_ACT while explaining that ACT is calibrated off Planck; current official combined SPT/ACT/Planck configuration instead uses A_ACT=A_planck. Both mappings are exposed. Default here follows the official implementation and is not claimed to be exact author reproduction.
ACT_scale_ambiguity: Paper does not list upper ACT multipole cuts; current ACT wrapper defaults to6500 while current official combined SPT config uses8500. Default6500 and explicit8500 sensitivity are exposed.
priors: Keep the broad baseline cosmological priors for a data-combination comparison, not the paper's evidence priors. Use stated Gaussian calibration priors and flat foreground0..2. Clear candl's internal tau/calibration priors to avoid double counting lowE/calibration.
theory: CAMB1.6.6 PPF analytic CPL and its effective w+wa<=0 domain; lens_potential_accuracy4, lens_margin1250, lmax9000, mead2016. Verify one higher-accuracy evaluation before scientific use.
independence: The paper argues residual Planck/ACT multipole and ACT/SPT sky overlap is immaterial. This is an adopted likelihood-factorization approximation, not independently measured zero cross-covariance. Joint ACT/Planck lensing includes its released cross covariance.
checks: Actual data rather than bundled simulated fallback
Joint lensing data/covariance dimensions and Hartlap convention
Reference evaluation and cached nuisance/cosmology timings
